tut.hello:
Hi! I'm Mint.
Let's merge things and build a garden with our friends!
tut.spawner:
Tap the [[basket]] basket below.
It uses [[energy]]{n} to drop a seed. Try it three times!
tut.merge:
Drag two matching items onto each other
to merge them into the next one!
tut.orders:
These are your friends' requests.
A card glows when the item is on the board. Tap it to deliver and earn [[star]] stars!
tut.decor:
Spend [[star]] stars to decorate the garden.
Decorations bring new friends!

Items on the board earn [[coin]] coins by themselves.
Tap the garden to see it up close. Let's go!
